graniteskills.granite.command.graniteski: Use: /graniteskills <subcommand …> — /skills, /sk, and /skill share the same subcommand mirror (Sprint 65); includes manaability (Sprint 66), antiafk (Sprint 67); per-skill top-level shortcuts (Sprint 68: /mining, /farming, … if enabled in config) are separate; top-level /backup, /preset, /storage, /profile, /transfer, /claimitems (Sprint 71: menu, /claimitems all = merge), /openmenu (includes unclaimed_items, leaderboard — Sprint 72, abilities — Sprint 73), etc.  —  see fabric/COMMAND_PARITY_AUDIT.md
graniteskills.granite.command.help: Fabric GraniteSkills: /graniteskills (reload, save, help, version, and all mirrors below) | /skills, /sk, /skill = same subtree: openmenu (includes leaderboard, abilities — Sprints 72–73), top/skilltop/rank/skillrank/updateleaderboards, multiplier/toggle/abtoggle/lang, modifier, trait, item, armor, xp, mana, skilllevel, manaability (resetcooldown, staff), antiafk (logs, staff), claimitems (|all), sources, resethealth, transfer, profile, backup, preset, storage | /stats | top-level per-skill: /farming, /mining, … (Sprint 68, if enabled) | /backup, /preset, /storage, /profile, /transfer, /claimitems, /openmenu, /mana, /skilllevel, /xp, /sources… | staff: reload/save; resethealth & storage confirm: console/RCON; abtoggle = action bar, not mana ability cooldowns

graniteskills.granite.command.backup.inf:
Granite /backup (Sprints 60–61, read fabric/SPRINT_61…):
— Perms: graniteskills.command.backup = create|save|list|info (default deny). graniteskills.command.backup.load = load|restore (default deny).
— create|save: one timestamped .yml under backups/ via BackupProvider (saves online users, then loadStates → UserState snapshot).
— load|restore <file> confirm: two-step; basename only, must stay under backups/; pre-restore automatic backup; then common loadBackup (UserState v1/v2). Not a full config/messages/loot/menus restore.
— list/info: see above.
— Skips: delete, schedules, cloud, SQL dump. Large servers: automatic_backups.max_users can skip pre-backup/backup create.
